title: SPECTRA: State-Space Exogenous Context and Temporal-Frequency Resolution Architecture for Probabilistic Energy Forecasting
claim: An architecture that separates deterministic and residual streams and aligns exogenous context with both achieves the best CRPS in 14 of 18 load, price, solar and wind settings, 5.74% below the strongest baselines on average.
why_relevant: Probabilistic load forecasting with exogenous inputs including temperature; a trained architecture, not a zero-shot model.

title: A Later Test Set Is Not a New Domain: Pretraining Familiarity Survives a Contamination-Free Hold-Out
claim: On a hold-out made only of observations published after every model's release, pretrained forecasters win 5 of 7 groups, and what tracks their advantage is how familiar the domain is from pretraining, not seasonality of the series.
why_relevant: Our receipt reports weeks after the weights date; this says a later test window does not remove domain familiarity.

title: Evaluating Accuracy and Probabilistic Reliability of Zero-Shot Time Series Foundation Models
claim: From the title only (page not fetched): an evaluation of accuracy and probabilistic reliability of zero-shot pretrained forecasters.
